youtube.title: Durable Queues Explained with One Simple Visual Flow
alternateTitles: How Durable Queues Keep Background Work Moving Safely
Understand Producer Queue Consumer Architecture Visually
youtube.description:
See how a durable queue separates submission from processing so consumers can retry independently.

What you'll learn:
- Why producers should not wait for consumers
- How queues preserve pending work
- Where independent retries fit
